rows.grounds: yugma = pair (opposites); grāsa = devouring/consuming; ablative sense. Aligns with centre-between-opposites doctrine (Transmission brief B/C).
nir- = without; avakāśa = space/interval/opportunity. Describes immediacy without gap (Transmission brief C: suddenness).
saṃvit = consciousness/awareness; niṣṭhā = established/abiding/fixed. Indicates firm establishment in consciousness (Transmission brief B: mahāsāhasa).
